metadata.name: Session host configuration remediation template
metadata.description: Deploys automated session-host initialization as a named Run Command on an existing VM for policy remediation.

output.value: [if(or(not(parameters('requested')), contains(createArray('ActiveDirectoryDomainServices', 'EntraDomainServices'), parameters('identitySolution'))), true(), fail('FSLogix Object Specific Settings require AD-domain-joined session hosts. FederalAVD EntraKerberos-Hybrid, EntraKerberos-CloudOnly, and EntraId modes use Entra-only joined hosts. Use ShardPerms with Entra Kerberos instead.'))]
